# bolerish/edge

> A little more alive. Connect existing UI components to one shared directional light while keeping their markup, colors and interactions.

The React 18/19 adapter is @bolerish/edge. Import @bolerish/edge/style.css once, before application and utility styles; a separate reset may load first. No styling compiler or style-injection provider is required. See Installation for consumer commands and stylesheet setup, and CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository for local development. Dedicated Vue, Svelte and Solid adapters are not implemented.

Edge.Provider creates a shared scope without adding DOM. Only explicit Edge.Surface descendants respond; nested scopes are independent. Use useSurface(options) inside Edge.Provider to connect existing hosts, passing the callback ref returned by useSurface to the host. Keep your existing className and style; Edge owns its decorative bindings. Hooks add decoration after hydration; Edge.Surface also emits decorative styles during SSR.

Edge ships plain CSS. Each surface uses its own currentColor and inherits its host border-radius by default; Edge preserves background, padding and base borders.

The edgeStyle option accepts raised, recessed and matte. The motion option accepts system (the library default), dynamic and static. staticDirection accepts a finite angle in degrees or "random", sampled once per light mount. The documentation site defaults to Dynamic and its Style and Motion controls update site preferences.

Decoration uses ::after by default. Select pseudoElement: "before" when ::after is occupied. Use wrappers for native inputs or hosts using both pseudo-elements. Edge.Provider is decorative and does not replace focus, contrast or validation states. Position changes or host border-thickness changes without a size notification can require refresh(); rotated or perspective geometry and cross-document portals are unsupported. SSR and static rendering are supported; interactive tracking requires JavaScript. No performance advantage is claimed.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](/docs/): Shared-light concepts and scope.
- [Installation](/docs/installation/): Package manager commands, stylesheet setup and AI installation prompt.
- [Usage](/docs/usage/): Shared areas, selected surfaces and existing UI ownership.
- [React Integration](/docs/react/usage/): React component example, client boundaries and existing-host connections.
- [Style](/docs/styles/): Surface appearance values.
- [Motion](/docs/motion/): Input behavior, static direction and reduced motion.
- [Integration](/docs/integration/): Shared input-wrapper, decoration and layout constraints.
- [Accessibility](/docs/accessibility/): Native controls, focus and forced colors.
- [React API reference](/docs/react/api/): Complete props, hooks, defaults and cleanup contracts.

Rendering: CSR, SSR and hydratable SSG are supported. Edge.Surface emits appearance classes/variables during server rendering; geometry and lighting activate on the client. useSurface decorates hosts only after hydration. Node renderToPipeableStream and Web renderToReadableStream are tested with delayed Suspense surfaces and hydration of completed output. Await all content for hydratable SSG. renderToStaticMarkup output is not hydratable. Server Component frameworks need a client module marked "use client". Tests do not establish every framework/runtime or incomplete-stream selective hydration.
